simple.summary: פִּקֵּחַ (piqqêach) means clear-sighted ; figuratively, intelligent First listed occurrence: Exod 4 11.

definitions.full: H6493. piqqeach מִּקֵּחַ adjective seeing ; — ׳פ Exod 4:11 (opposed to עִוֵּר ); plural מִּקְחִים , figurative, 23:8 clear-sighted ones (compare [ עָוַר ]).
